about: Reviewed verdicts for claims the checks cannot settle alone, each for the exact claim it names (pass, tier, card, frame, field, exact text, ctx: the hash of the boards, moves, try, reply and step it is read against). Written by test/truth/py/adjudicate.py; see test/truth/README.md.
